meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先运行 `senpi --list-tips` 获取当前可用提示列表，再读取该用户的设置和提示历史，确认你实际能看到的提示，最后查看功能源码，用你的语言给出含文件路径的深度解释；源码与提示文字矛盾时以代码为准。
howto.when: 当你问界面里某条“Tip:”是什么意思、说“give-me-tips”，或想了解提示对应的功能如何工作时触发。

say.text: 刚才终端里那条 “Tip:” 讲的是什么？
say.note: Claude 会先查列表，再结合你的配置解释。

say.text: 给我讲讲 give-me-tips 是怎么验证提示的。
say.note: 它会说明查询实时列表和源码比对的流程。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后的那条提示，背后的机制是什么？
say.note: 会走专门的 fallback-architect 流程讲解。

howto.what_en: On install, Claude queries `senpi --list-tips`, reads your settings/history to see which tips YOU can see, then verifies the feature code before explaining; it cites file paths, and code wins over tip text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about a “Tip:” line, say “give-me-tips”, or ask how a tipped feature works.

say_en.text: What does that “Tip:” line in the terminal mean?
say_en.note: Claude will check the list and tailor to your config.

say_en.text: Explain how give-me-tips verifies a tip.
say_en.note: It will describe the live-list lookup and code comparison.

say_en.text: What mechanics hide behind the Fable 5 refusal tip?
say_en.note: It walks through the fallback-architect pipeline.
